name: Boracay
content: Boracay is famous for White Beach and watersports.

name: Palawan (El Nido)
content: El Nido offers dramatic karst landscapes and clear lagoons.

name: Palawan (Coron)
content: Coron is a top wreck-diving and snorkeling site.

name: Chocolate Hills (Bohol)
content: The Chocolate Hills are a geological formation of over 1,000 hills.

name: Banaue Rice Terraces
short_description: Ancient rice terraces carved into the mountains.
content: A UNESCO World Heritage site built by indigenous people.

name: Vigan
content: Vigan is known for its preserved colonial townscape.

name: Mayon Volcano (Legazpi)
short_description: Perfect cone volcano and outdoor activities.
content: Mayon Volcano offers scenic views and hiking opportunities.

name: Cebu (Kawasan Falls)
content: Kawasan Falls is famous for canyoneering and clear waters.

name: Siargao
content: Siargao is famous for Cloud 9 surf break and laid-back vibe.

name: Intramuros (Manila)
content: Intramuros contains Fort Santiago and colonial-era churches.

name: Taal Volcano
short_description: Crater lake within a volcano island.
content: Taal Volcano features a lake within a volcanic island.

name: Panglao Island (Bohol)
content: Panglao offers resorts, beaches, and diving access to coral reefs.

name: Davao (Eden Nature Park)
content: Eden Nature Park is a cool highland retreat near Davao City.

name: Hundred Islands (Pangasinan)
short_description: Cluster of small islands with beaches.
content: Hundred Islands National Park is popular for island hopping.

name: Fortune Island (Batangas)
content: Fortune Island is known for Grecian-style ruins and clear waters.

name: Apo Island
short_description: Marine sanctuary for turtles and snorkeling.
content: Apo Island is a protected marine sanctuary with abundant turtles.

name: Samal Island
short_description: Beaches and beach resorts near Davao.
content: Samal Island is popular for resorts and white-sand beaches.

name: Camiguin
short_description: Small island with volcanoes and hot springs.
content: Camiguin offers hot springs, waterfalls, and diving.

name: Mt. Pulag
short_description: Highest peak in Luzon with sea-of-clouds.
content: Mt. Pulag is famed for its sunrise sea of clouds and trekking.

name: Pagudpud
short_description: Beaches and coastal scenery in northern Luzon.
content: Pagudpud is known for its pristine beaches and windmills.
